Sasha K.: quick smoke from SG edge: ran reranker-v2-small (fp16 and int8-quant) across cpu vs gpu for dims {128,256}, batches {1,4,8,16}. posting raw numbers below 

Sasha K.: TL;DR: GPU wins for batch>=8 for both dims. CPU throughput competitive at dim=128 batch<=4; int8 helps CPU latency but quality needs QA. 

Sasha K.: run command: `./bench_rerank --model rerank-v2-small --region sg --nodes 1 --runs 50 --dims 128,256 --batches 1,4,8,16 --quant int8,fp16 --devices cpu,gpu` 

bench-bot: automated summary attached: 
```
Summary (SG, single-node, p95 latency ms, qps avg):
- dim=128, batch=1: cpu(fp32)=18.5ms (qps=54), cpu(int8)=15.2ms (qps=66), gpu(fp16)=6.8ms (qps=147)
- dim=128, batch=4: cpu(fp32)=45.9ms (qps=87), cpu(int8)=33.1ms (qps=121), gpu(fp16)=12.4ms (qps=322)
- dim=128, batch=8: cpu(fp32)=92.0ms (qps=87), cpu(int8)=68.3ms (qps=117), gpu(fp16)=19.9ms (qps=643)
- dim=128, batch=16: cpu(fp32)=175.3ms (qps=91), cpu(int8)=140.7ms (qps=113), gpu(fp16)=34.7ms (qps=896)

- dim=256, batch=1: cpu(fp32)=32.1ms (qps=31), cpu(int8)=25.4ms (qps=39), gpu(fp16)=9.7ms (qps=102)
- dim=256, batch=4: cpu(fp32)=78.6ms (qps=50), cpu(int8)=58.2ms (qps=68), gpu(fp16)=18.1ms (qps=228)
- dim=256, batch=8: cpu(fp32)=156.0ms (qps=51), cpu(int8)=120.9ms (qps=66), gpu(fp16)=31.0ms (qps=453)
- dim=256, batch=16: cpu(fp32)=310.2ms (qps=51), cpu(int8)=245.6ms (qps=64), gpu(fp16)=56.4ms (qps=643)
```

Mike L.: nice. can you add p99 and memory numbers? also which GPU type was this? 

Sasha K.: SG node has a single A10G-equivalent. p99s: ~1.8x p95 on cpu, ~1.4x on gpu. Peak memory: dim256 batch16 on GPU ~11.2GB, cpu peak RSS ~28GB (due to threading + mmap). 

Tanya R.: quality check on int8? any regression on NDCG or AP vs fp16? 

Sasha K.: initial eval on our 1k holdout queries: int8 delta NDCG@10 = -0.6% (stdev 0.3). small but consistent. need to run full eval suite before promoting. 

DevOps Jay: from infra POV interesting: CPU path saturates cores and pushes network (serialization). For small batches CPU is OK but at scale we see lots of context switches. GPU gives much smoother qps scaling. 

Mike L.: suggestion — for SG region set default routing: dim<=128 & batch<=4 -> cpu-int8 fallback allowed; else route to GPU. can we simulate cost delta? 

Sasha K.: quick cost back-of-envelope: on our pricing, cpu-int8 per-1000-reqs ~= $0.42, gpu(fp16) per-1000-reqs ~= $0.95 at these loads. so CPU is ~2x cheaper for small dims/batches. 

Tanya R.: let's gate int8 rollout behind full-eval and 5k query QA. also run a canary with golden prompts that exercise tail cases (near-duplicates). 

Sasha K.: agreed. next steps: 1) run full eval for int8 (5k) 2) collect p99/p999 and memory traces 3) microbenchmark batch-level scaling on A100-equivalent in EU to compare cross-region kernel variance. will post results in this thread.

Mike L.: thanks. small nit — can you paste the raw bench script output (csv) into the thread when done? that helps SRE for capacity planning. :thumbsup: 

Sasha K.: will do. leaving the smoke results here for visibility. ping me if you want the raw traces earlier. :eyes:
